messages:
mia: kicking off sample-mining + onboarding plan for stella-13b-introducer. goal: pick a small but representative eval slice to detect AWQ vs GPTQ regressions early.

sam: baseline numbers from fp16 on hosted (p99 latency 180ms, ppl 2.7 on golden set). we need clear delta thresholds.

alisha: proposed thresholds: perf: <=+5% token latency; quality: no >2.5% drop in exact-match on golden QA, and no >3% drop on safety injection tests.

mia: sounds reasonable. also want traffic split plan for canary across hosted/dedicated/private. thinking: 0.5% hosted, 0.2% dedicated, 0.1% private to start. ramp rules: double every 30m if metrics stable.

rene: add hard fail conditions: error rate >0.5%, 95th latency >2x baseline, or any safety-policy false positives increase. rollback immediately if triggered.

sam: for quant variants we should run microbench profiling first. CLI snippet I used:
```
./profile_model --model stella-13b --quant awq-8bit --seq 1024 --microbatch 8 --device a100
```
we capture token/sec, kv-mem, peak-gpu.

mia: sample mining: pull 2k samples stratified by length (<=64, 65-256, 256-1024), plus 300 edge safety prompts, and 200 high-recall rerank queries. that should cover common failure modes.

alisha: where will eval happen? hosted staging for AWQ/GPTQ, dedicated reserved pool for profiling, private on a customer's sim infra for final smoke.

sam: agree. also instrument per-token distribution diffs and embedding drift (cosine) on the golden set. add an automated alert if mean embedding cosine drops >0.015.

ci-bot: new pipeline triggered: quant-onboard/2201234567. steps: profile -> eval-golden -> safety-run -> canary-rollout. See run: CI-9872.

mia: rollout policy detail: initial traffic weights as above, but implement corridor fallback: requests failing quality gates route to fp16-hosted fallback. keep per-customer sticky routing for 10m.

rene: telemetry: capture per-route cost delta, token failure taxonomy, and a flag for hallucination spikes (measured by hallucination-detector >=0.6). If any hallucination spike for 5% of samples, auto-fail.

alisha: can we automate sample reweighting? idea: if a segment (length bucket or intent) shows >1.5x regression, double its sampling in next eval iterate.

sam: implementation note: when running on private we sometimes see kernel fuzz due to cudnn versions; add a binary compatibility checklist and checksum in the onboarding run notes.

mia: next steps: sam to run microprofile + initial eval by EOD, ci-bot to publish results, alisha to provision dedicated slice, rene to bake in rollback hooks. meet tomorrow 11am to decide AWQ vs GPTQ swap.

rene: ack. adding a scheduled alert: #incidents will get paged only on hard fail, otherwise notify in eng-ml channel.

mia: thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for decisions. will attach golden set and scripts in the run artifacts. :thumbsup:
